origin_semantics: Northwest bottom corner of bounding box; +X east, +Y up, +Z south
chunks: Not restricted to 16x16; crosses multiple chunks, actual count depends on world origin alignment
placement_preconditions: Check whole volume for occupied blocks, entities, fluids and world border, including explicit air.
Reject unsafe overlap; do not clear or overwrite player structures.

scale_from_reference.method: Visual proportion estimate, not exact image measurement
scale_from_reference.doors: 5-wide by 4-high lower opening; stepped arch narrows toward crown at y7
scale_from_reference.comparison: Preserves low central plinth relative to tall surrounding walls; no one-chunk shrink
scale_from_reference.verification: Walk paths use actual native block collisions; visual match is a human-review candidate, not a perfect-replica claim
